subject: Cloud market acquisition path eval — AWS marketplace preference & PO path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@caldera.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: cloud acquisition path recap (AWS Marketplace vs PO)

Alyssa — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: pilot Redwood inference for batch scoring pipeline and customer-facing chat assistant (low-latency requirements for chat; batch for overnight scoring).
- Preference: AWS region (us-west-2) and interest in buying via AWS Marketplace if we can support consolidated billing and a standard PO for SOW-related services.
- Procurement constraints: purchasing team requires a W-9 + vendor form; finance prefers invoice/PO flow but can use card for pilot under $10k.

Questions we need answered to align the commercial path
1) Is Caldera able to accept an AWS Marketplace Private Offer (PO) so payments flow through their AWS invoice? Or do you need Redwood to invoice directly via PO?
2) Who on your procurement team will own the vendor form and PO issuance? (you mentioned procurement@caldera.ai)
3) Any constrained timelines for pilot start — you mentioned wanting pilot by mid-September if procurement clears.

Proposed next steps
- I will attach our short Marketplace buying guide and a draft SOW for review (see attachments).
- Priyom (cc) will send a quick technical checklist for region/KMS and network egress to validate Private deployment assumptions.
- If procurement is open to Marketplace Private Offers, I’ll coordinate legal and pricing to issue a Private Offer and provide a DocuSign PO flow. Otherwise, we’ll prepare an invoice/PO quote.

Would you be able to confirm procurement contact and whether Marketplace Private Offer is acceptable by EOD next week? Happy to set a short call with procurement if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Buying_Guide.pdf, SOW-draft-Caldera.docx
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@caldera.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@caldera.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: cloud acquisition path recap (AWS Marketplace vs PO)

Thanks, Karthik — great recap and appreciated the clear next steps.

On our side:
- Procurement contact is procurement@caldera.ai (looping them here).
- Finance prefers PO/invoice for any purchase > $5k. For pilots under $10k we can use card if necessary but prefer PO route for audit trail.
- We are interested in AWS Marketplace Private Offer because it simplifies billing for our platform teams, but we need confirmation that Redwood will accept Private Offer terms (net-30 on our invoice through AWS).
- Timeline: we want pilot started by 2026-09-20 if procurement can move quickly; otherwise aim for early October.

I’ll have procurement review the attachments and get back with required vendor forms.

Best,
Alyssa Grant
Head of Product | Caldera Analytics
alyssa@caldera.ai

--
procurement@caldera.ai
Sent on behalf of Caldera Procurement Team
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@caldera.ai>, procurement@caldera.ai
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-31T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: cloud acquisition path recap (AWS Marketplace vs PO) — quick tech & billing notes

Hi Alyssa / procurement team — Priyom here (SE). Two short items to unblock procurement and the pilot: 

1) Technical prerequisites for Marketplace Private Offer (if you choose that route)
- We can provision in your AWS account via Private Offer; we will need the AWS account ID and a contact with Marketplace admin privileges.
- For KMS: if you plan to use your own KMS keys for encryption at rest, we’ll need key ARNs and IAM role/assumption details (we can template the required permissions).

2) Billing / PO logistics
- Private Offer path: once the Private Offer is accepted in AWS, charges will show on your AWS invoice; Redwood will reconcile that and send a fulfillment confirmation invoice. Typical net terms are 30 days after AWS invoice receipt.
- Direct invoice path: Redwood will issue an invoice to Caldera; PO is accepted as payment authorization and standard net-30 terms apply.

Actionables
- Alyssa / procurement: please share your AWS account ID and any vendor form or W-9 contact.
- Karthik: I’ll draft a short checklist for KMS/region (attaching a lightweight one-pager).

-Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_TECH_Checklist_aws_kms_region.pdf
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T10:55:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: pricing / approvals for Caldera pilot

Karthik / Priyom — quick note on commercial: 
- We can approve a pilot discount up to 25% off list for Caldera under AE approval. For anything beyond that I need a short justification and manager approval.
- If they prefer Marketplace Private Offer, we’ll need legal to review the standard PO wording for net-30 via AWS (this typically takes 3 business days).
- Keep me posted if procurement asks for a PO that needs to be signed by Redwood legal — I’ll loop Legal (cc: legal@redwood.com).

I recommend offering Marketplace Private Offer as the primary route since it reduces procurement friction on their side; have Karthik propose a 90-day pilot quote with the pilot discount and card fallback for procurement timeline slippage.

-Marissa
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@caldera.ai>, procurement@caldera.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: cloud acquisition path recap (AWS Marketplace vs PO) — next steps & timeline

Alyssa / procurement team — thanks for the quick turn. Next steps and timeline on our side: 

1) Marketplace Private Offer path (preferred)- I’ll have our Commercial team prepare a Private Offer and price it as a 90-day pilot at a 20% pilot discount (per Marissa’s guidance). Expect a DocuSign link for acceptance and a Private Offer email to your AWS admin by 2026-09-06.

2) Fallback (direct invoice + PO)- If procurement needs a standard PO, we’ll prepare a direct invoice quote and accept a Caldera-issued PO; Redwood terms are net-30. Please share your PO template or vendor form.

3) Technical prep- Priyom will send the lightweight tech checklist (already attached in prior email). If you can share the AWS account ID and KMS contact by 2026-09-08, we’ll provision resources in us-west-2 and aim to start the pilot week of 2026-09-20.

4) Documents- Attached: Redwood_Marketplace_Buying_Guide.pdf, SOW-draft-Caldera.docx (draft SOW shows pilot scope and KPIs).

If that timeline works, I’ll calendar a 15-minute procurement sync for next week to walk through the Private Offer acceptance flow (I find this helps procurement feel comfortable with the marketplace path).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_Buying_Guide.pdf, SOW-draft-Caldera.docx
